presets.name: Studio dreadnought
presets.desc: Electric DI to a miked dreadnought between sound hole and neck, a light comp and room
presets.notes: The reference: neck single coil, modal lows, the decay stage at the model's own shortening

presets.name: Big jumbo strum
presets.desc: A jumbo body with more boom under strummed chords, compressed for a band mix
presets.notes: Body 60 % lifts the modal bank 2.4 dB: the deeper air and top modes of the larger box

presets.name: Fingerstyle concert
presets.desc: The measured grand-concert body, a brighter attack and shorter sustain between picks
presets.notes: Concert is fitted from public-domain recordings of a steel-string; decay 60 % shortens tails between picks

presets.name: Single-note lead
presets.desc: Long electric notes decay like an acoustic's: the sustain that gives a sim away is gone
presets.notes: Where the decay stage acts fully: single lines and long notes

presets.name: Parlor blues
presets.desc: A small-body parlor: boxy midrange, a little more top, a small room
presets.notes: Parlor's modes sit about 20 % higher than the dreadnought's (body area); body 40 % keeps the boom down

presets.name: Nylon bossa
presets.desc: The archive-fitted classical body, dark top and a short nylon decay, miked near the neck
presets.notes: Classical is fitted from a measured Spanish concert guitar (CC BY 4.0 archive); its k is higher in the highs

presets.name: Twelve-string jangle
presets.desc: Octave and unison courses added before the body, detuned and strummed late, compressed
presets.notes: Octave voice below 400 Hz from the ERB bank, unison above 150 Hz; 4 cents and 2.5 ms on the shifter's 3 ms

presets.name: Stage acoustic
presets.desc: Piezo and mic blended with the lows cut: cuts through a loud band and resists feedback
presets.notes: The piezo voice is F̂ through the force conversion plus a 2 kHz bell; low cut 100 Hz keeps the body boom out

presets.name: Round-back stage
presets.desc: A subdued round-back body with a strong piezo voice: the bright stage acoustic
presets.notes: Few low-Q modes and a short tail, as the round-back's subdued body resonance

presets.name: Piezo restore
presets.desc: An acoustic-electric's piezo DI given back its body and mic, quack tamed, blended with the DI
presets.notes: Concert with a piezo source is the measured guitar's own piezo-to-mic response; pick the nearest body

presets.name: Electric to acoustic
presets.desc: Mix on the expression pedal: morph the electric DI into the miked acoustic mid-song
presets.notes: Put EXP on mix 0 → 100 %: the wet has no bulk delay, so the sweep has no comb

presets.name: Wide doubled acoustic
presets.desc: Two microphones from one body on a stereo lane, a little room
presets.notes: 2 / 2 only: the mics sit at mic ± width / 2 on the same modal bank; the lows stay coherent

presets.name: Bridge-pickup rescue
presets.desc: A bridge humbucker turned into a usable acoustic: position shelf and aperture shelf
presets.notes: The position shelf adds up to 13.8 dB of lows re the treble; top 45 % trims what the guess leaves

presets.name: Small-body morph
presets.desc: The body shrinks under the expression pedal: every mode glides up, no click
presets.notes: Put EXP on size 140 → 80 %: modes at f · 100 / size, coefficients ramped every 32 samples

presets.name: Ringing sustain
presets.desc: The measured concert body with the electric's full sustain kept, a larger room
presets.notes: Decay 0 is bit-exact pass-through of the strings' sustain: long notes ring as on the electric
